lines: How does a giant plane actually stay up?
You were told the air on top races to catch up? Nope, that's a myth!
Its wings are tilted and curved, so they shove loads of air downwards...
And pushing air down pushes the plane up! Like your hand out of a car window.
Fast air over the top also has lower pressure, so the wing gets sucked up too.
But it only works with speed. That's why planes race down the runway!
